import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { users } from "./users";
import { nodes } from "./nodes";
import { relations } from "./relations";
import { ways } from "./ways";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "title" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const redactions = defineTable("redactions", {
    columns: {
        id: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        title: col.text().notNull(),
        description: col.text().notNull(),
        createdAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone"),
        updatedAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone"),
        userId: col.bigint().notNull(),
        descriptionFormat: col.enum(["html", "markdown", "text"], { name: "format_enum" }).notNull().default("markdown")
    },
    relations: {
        user: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        nodes: rel.hasMany(() => nodes),
        relations: rel.hasMany(() => relations),
        ways: rel.hasMany(() => ways)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
